summary.story: 18×2 Beyond Youthful Days is a 2024 romance film directed by Michihito Fujii and produced by Chang Chen. Starring Greg Hsu and Kaya Kiyohara, alongside an ensemble cast including Joseph Chang, Shunsuke Michieda, Haru Kuroki, Hitomi Kuroki, and Yutaka Matsushige, the film follows a recently fired Taiwanese video game developer (Hsu) on a solo trip to Japan, reminiscing about a past romantic entanglement with a Japanese backpacker (Kiyohara) that never blossomed into a relationship. Adapted from a web travelogue by Taiwanese video game developer Jimmy Lai in 2014, the film was stuck in development hell before Japanese filmmaker Michihito Fujii joined the project in 2019, turning it into a collaborative film between Taiwan and Japan. Alan Chu of United Daily News wrote that instead of being a "Taiwanese-flavored Japanese film" or "Japanese-flavored Taiwanese film", director Michihito Fujii "carefully balances the aesthetic tones of both regions" while incorporating "pure-love elements" reminiscent of You Are the Apple of My Eye (2011) and At Cafe 6 (2016), remarking that "the film is primarily aimed at commercial success".
